questions.q: What is a Personal Developer Instance (PDI)?
options: A limited demo simulator with fake data
A free, full-featured ServiceNow instance requested through developer.servicenow.com for learning and building
A paid add-on required to use ServiceNow at all
A read-only preview of the ServiceNow UI
questions.explain: A PDI is a genuine, complete instance of the Now Platform, free to request through ServiceNow's developer program.

questions.q: What access level do you get on your own PDI by default?
options: A limited guest role with no configuration access
Read-only access
Full administrative access (admin)
Access only to Incident Management
questions.explain: Requesting a PDI provisions an instance where you are the admin, with full configuration and administrative capability.

questions.q: What happens to a PDI that goes unused for an extended period of inactivity?
options: It is permanently and irreversibly deleted
Nothing changes — it stays fully active forever
It goes dormant/hibernates and must be manually woken up from the developer portal before logging in again
It automatically upgrades to a production license
questions.explain: Inactive PDIs hibernate to save resources; they're paused, not deleted, and need to be woken up from developer.servicenow.com.

questions.q: Which of these is a real limitation of a PDI mentioned in this lesson?
options: It is licensed strictly for learning, prototyping, and skill-building — never for running a real business's production ITSM
It cannot be used to create tables or forms
It has no admin access at all
It cannot run Incident Management
questions.explain: PDIs are full-featured for learning purposes but are never intended for actual production use by a real organization.

questions.q: How does this course's labs handle the fact that not every student will have a PDI open?
options: Labs are skipped entirely if you don't have a PDI
Labs require screenshots of a real instance to follow along
Labs are written as worked scenarios with real table/field/menu names, followable conceptually or replicable on your own PDI
Labs assume everyone already has a paid production instance
questions.explain: The course's labs are concrete worked scenarios, usable whether or not you personally have a PDI requested and awake.
